title: how file and note vectors get built by the embedder daemon
summary: File and note vectors are never built by a reader: the keeper writes g<N>-sketches.jsonl in the same cache generation on every save, pings the per-machine embedder daemon (spawning it if absent), and the daemon diffs content-hash keys against that repo's vector store and embeds only what is missing, in the background at ~50% duty. A daemon restart therefore re-embeds nothing, and a body-only edit costs nothing because the sketch is path + symbol names. Opt-in for now: nothing runs unless COLDSTART_EMBEDDER=1 or `init --embedder` wrote ~/.coldstart/embedder/enabled.

title: how file and note vectors get built by the embedder daemon
summary: File and note vectors are never built by a reader: the keeper writes g<N>-sketches.jsonl in the same cache generation on every save and pings the per-machine embedder daemon (spawning it if absent); `kb write` and the recall gate ping it with notes-changed. The daemon diffs content-hash keys against that repo's vector store and embeds only what is missing, in the background: it tokenizes each item ITSELF (its one Rust tokenizer) and sends token ids to its MAIN model child process (hooks/embed-worker.mjs, a session only), a long note one 1024-token window per call. What gets embedded depends on the opt-in: WITHOUT it (a daemon the recall gate spawned) only NOTES are embedded; with COLDSTART_EMBEDDER=1 or ~/.coldstart/embedder/enabled the file sketches are too; an explicit off wins for everything. Not every indexed file gets a sketch: sketchFilter drops DATA (symbol-less data-format files, and data-format or symbol-less files in a directory with > 100 files of the same extension) — a repo with 36k raw XBRL .xml + data .json went 36,539 → 208 sketches; README/index.html/package.json are kept. A repo with no sketches yet still gets its notes embedded, but no sweep runs then. A daemon restart re-embeds nothing, and a body-only edit costs nothing because the sketch is path + symbol names.
